name: UNO TIMBER 60ft
tagline: High-capacity timber wagon for efficient and secure transport of roundwood and sawn timber.
intro: The UNO TIMBER 60ft Rnoos is designed to maximize efficiency throughout the timber logistics chain. Its lightweight construction combines high payload capacity with optimized loading performance.

The wagon features a robust, optimized stanchion arrangement that ensures reliable cargo retention without additional securing of roundwood. Designed to accommodate 3, 4 and 5 m timber lengths, it provides flexibility for different loading requirements.
benefits: High payload with low tare weight
Optimized for 3, 4 and 5 m timber lengths
Secure roundwood retention without additional tying

special: Transport of 3, 4 and 5m long round timber wood
